payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about previously reported results in speculation detection tasks, including improvements in performance metrics over prior work.

claims.text: Previous work on speculation detection reported results that were improved by at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
The CoNLL-2010 Shared Task included speculation cue detection and scope resolution as subtasks, which have been the focus of various studies over the years.
